svg.title: Career timeline of Pavan Reddy Mogili: B.Tech in Computer Engineering at JNTU (2015 to 2019); Software Engineer at Cognizant (2019 to 2021); M.S. in Data Science at Northeastern University with a 4.0 GPA and graduate teaching assistant roles (2021 to 2023); Machine Learning Intern at Affinia Therapeutics (2022); Senior Data Scientist at Fidelity Investments (2023 to now); doctoral program at the University of the Cumberlands (2026 to now); building Turtledove, an iOS app (2026).
